data.hypothesis: The prior direct-acceleration candidate failed one checked output at N=16384 after changing both the interaction math and target-mass handling. This variant isolates rsqrtf cubing while restoring the target-mass multiplication and final division from T1. It may reduce per-pair math cost, but correctness and speed remain to be measured.
data.notes: Only src/nbody_kernel.cu changes. The T1 launch remains block=128, items_per_block=128, shared_memory_bytes=4096. The prior candidate's single mismatch does not identify the cause; this version restores target-mass operations and must be checked afresh before timing. No performance claim is made.
transformations: Retain T1's one-target-per-thread mapping, shared-memory source tiles, and launch parameters.
Use rsqrtf(distSq) cubed with multiplications in place of sqrtf and the denominator division.
Restore target-mass multiplication in each force and division by target mass after accumulation.
